description: Give the size of a box, label, pouch, sack or pillow pack in millimetres and get its print-ready dieline (cut and fold lines, bleed) as PDF and SVG links, ready for the printer or any design software. Same engine as the free dieline generator on creadal.com. Free, no account needed. Sizes: box = length, width, height; label (wraps a bottle or jar) = diameter, height; pouch = width, height, optional gusset; sack = width, height, optional gusset; pillow = width, height, optional depth.

depth.description: Depth of a pillow pack, mm.

diameter.description: Container diameter for a label, mm.

gusset.description: Bottom gusset of a pouch, or side gusset of a sack, mm.

kind.description: What to make the dieline of.

width.description: Box depth, or the width of a pouch, sack or pillow pack, mm.

name: generate_dieline
title: Make a dieline
